name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Closet Dividers
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, offering a lightweight yet sturdy structure for long-term closet organization.
    - Made from 2mm thick wood, providing a slim profile while remaining durable for everyday use.
    - Features a sturdy built-in hook that fits securely over standard closet rods for easy hanging and repositioning.
    - Combines practical organization with charming personalized design, making it ideal for baby closets, kids’ wardrobes, and gift sets.
    - Designed to help keep clothing categories neat, visible, and easy to find.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 4 x 8 in ~ 10.16 x 20.32 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for clear details, vibrant colors, and a polished decorative appearance.
    - Support two-sided printing for easy visibility from different directions.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a closet organizer and a personalized decorative wardrobe accessory.
    - Helps separate clothes by age, size, season, style, or category.
    - Suitable for baby closets, kids’ wardrobes, nursery organization, boutique displays, and gift sets.
    - Makes clothing easier to sort, identify, and access quickly.
    - Ideal for organizing outfits from newborn stages to later growth milestones.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for parents, newborns, babies, toddlers, and growing families.
    - Perfect for baby showers, newborn welcomes, birthdays, nursery setup, and maternity gifts.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves neat closet organization with a cute personalized touch.
    - Great for helping parents keep baby clothes tidy and easy to browse.
    - A practical and charming gift choice that combines organization, decoration, and personalization.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Closet Dividers

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
